item.title: Director of Communications & Media Relations
item.description: Develops and executes strategic communications plans to promote the university’s key initiatives and advance the university’s reputation among targeted external and internal audiences. The Director oversees the creation and implementation of marketing campaigns across all communication channels with a particular focus on external media through the creation and/or sponsorship of events and earned media placements in regional and national news and trade publications
item.ns1:category: Position Type|Staff/Administration,Job Duration|Calendar Year (12-Month),Department|Marketing & Communications,Work Arrangement|Hybrid
item.ns1:description:
Summary

Develops and executes strategic communications plans to promote the university’s key initiatives and advance the university’s reputation among targeted external and internal audiences. The Director oversees the creation and implementation of marketing campaigns across all communication channels with a particular focus on external media through the creation and/or sponsorship of events and earned media placements in regional and national news and trade publications

 

Essential Job Functions

  • Develops and executes an integrated media relations strategy that drives measurable outcomes, media coverage, name recognition, brand awareness and institutional reputation
  • Develops, executes and shapes key talking points and written communications in order to reinforce the university’s mission, values, and strategic priorities
  • Creates and implements media outreach opportunities to promote the university by generating earned media coverage by national, regional, local and trade media, especially outlets that cover higher education and the industries related to academic areas
  • Manages and responds to media relations inquiries to leverage internal expertise and manage institutional reputation
  • Serves as a university spokesperson and prepares designated spokespeople as subject matter experts or within crisis situations
  • Creates thought leadership opportunities to leverage academic and other leaders as experts and university spokespeople
  • Provides ongoing media training for leadership and faculty
  • Develops strategies for reaching alternative and non-traditional media outlets
  • Facilitates industry speaking engagements or panelist opportunities for the university’s senior leadership team
  • Creates and produces regular reports tied to goals and outcomes
  • Represents the university on various professional association committees and at professional conferences, as needed
  • Supervises and develops the department staff, facilitating professional opportunities to improve individual capability and managing performance against job accountabilities, department goals and established university, campus and department policies and procedures.
  • Performs other duties as assigned

 

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of a bachelor's degree
  • Significant amount of experience working in communications, media relations, public relations or other related experience

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven track record of securing press coverage

 

Compensation: $105,000 - $110,000/annualized

Benefits: This full-time position offers a comprehensive beneﬁts package, which includes health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, long-term disability insurance, paid holidays, sick time, vacation time, a 401(k) retirement savings plan, health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts (FSA), educational assistance beneﬁts, and an employee assistance program. Participation in any benefit is subject to meeting eligibility criteria. The university reserves the right to modify, amend or terminate any benefit or benefit programs as they apply to any participants, including but not limited to current and former employees. This is only a summary; the full details, which control, are in the applicable plan documents.  

 

Please Note:

Qualified candidates must live or relocate to live within a daily commuting distance of the Providence Campus location upon hire.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis until job posting is closed.

item.description: Supports the university’s efforts related to planning, development, and implementation of trainings, referral pathways and supporting triage, crisis intervention and case management. This position is a one-year appointment funded by the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) Garrett Lee Smith (GLS) Campus Suicide Prevention Grant.

item.ns1:description:
Summary

Supports the university’s efforts related to planning, development, and implementation of trainings, referral pathways and supporting triage, crisis intervention and case management. This position is a one-year appointment funded by the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) Garrett Lee Smith (GLS) Campus Suicide Prevention Grant.

 

Essential Job Functions

  • Supports the development and management of the advisory council who will work to identify gaps in student mental health services, education, information and communication
  • Builds, expands and sustains relationships with internal and external stakeholders to strengthen available student referral networks for mental health and substance abuse
  • Collaborates with the university clinical team to provide student support through case management, triage and crisis intervention
  • Collaborates with the project director to engage community-based providers and develop formal student referral pathways
  • Serves as the primary program liaison supporting various internal and external meetings, as well as interactions with students, referral organizations and others, as appropriate
  • Collaborates with other university departments to maintain an understanding of internal student referral procedures in an effort to refer students in distress to the appropriate on-campus resources
  • Develops, organizes and implements relevant mental health and substance training and educational programming for the campus community to reduce stigma and increase access to care for university students
  • Organizes and develops social media campaigns surrounding mental health, substance abuse and crisis intervention
  • Supports the program director with long-term program planning
  • Performs other duties as assigned

 

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of a master's degree
  • Experience working in case management, direct clinical experience, experience working with diverse populations or other related experience
  • Clinical license in Rhode Island

item.title: Experiential Education & Career Advisor
item.description: Provides career and experiential education advising and related services to support students in their career planning and job search
item.ns1:category: Position Type|Staff/Administration,Department|Experiential Education & Career Services,Job Duration|Calendar Year (12-Month),Work Arrangement|Hybrid
item.ns1:description:
Summary

Provides career and experiential education advising and related services to support students in their career planning and job search

 

Essential Job Functions

  • Advises students on experiential education programs and collaborates with faculty to support seamless and quality experiences for students and employers
  • Researches, approves and manages employer sites for experiential education opportunities for students
  • Collaborates with employers and faculty in the evaluation of student performance and grades
  • Meets with students to advise on various job search activities, such as self-assessment, career planning, networking, resume development and interviewing
  • Responsible for actively engaging students and clubs and organizations to drive in-person and virtual student appointments
  • Supports students searching for employment and internships as well as other related experiential programs
  • Delivers student workshops on various career topics; teaches the career management course as needed
  • Communicates with various stakeholders, including students, faculty, parents and university staff, to provide information on department programs and services
  • Answers questions from various constituents in a professional and appropriate manner, following department and university guidelines for information sharing and efficient service
  • Participates in various career events
  • Maintains records and collects data per department guidelines
  • Performs other duties as assigned

 

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of a bachelor's degree
  • Experience working in career services, experiential education or other related experience

Qualified candidates must live or relocate to live within a daily commuting distance of the Charlotte Campus location upon hire.

item.title: Instructional Design & Technology Specialist
item.description: Works collaboratively with members of the department, faculty, and academics to enhance teaching and learning through the effective integration of instructional design principles and instructional technology
item.ns1:category: Position Type|Staff/Administration,Department|Instructional Design & Technology,Job Duration|Calendar Year (12-Month),Work Arrangement|Hybrid
item.ns1:description:
Summary

Works collaboratively with members of the department, faculty, and academics to enhance teaching and learning through the effective integration of instructional design principles and instructional technology 

 

Essential Job Functions

  • Supports course development, offers training, and maintains the quality and effectiveness of instructional strategies across various delivery formats, including face-to-face, hybrid, and online courses
  • Collaborates with faculty to design and develop new courses and revise existing ones, maintaining they meet university standards and learning outcomes
  • Develops and delivers faculty development in the effective application of instructional technologies and instructional design principles
  • Consults with faculty and other department staff on the identification and implementation of appropriate technology and instructional strategies to meet student learning outcomes
  • Troubleshoots and resolves matters related to instructional technologies for faculty and staff
  • Provides support to faculty for the learning management system, media tools, and other technologies for teaching
  • Identifies and assists in implementing innovative and effective learning techniques
  • Builds master course shells in the learning management system
  • Monitors online courses to confirm they meet quality standards and deadlines
  • Stays abreast of new technologies and strategies related to the implementation of instructional technologies and provides analysis and recommendations for improvement
  • Performs other duties as assigned

 

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of a master's degree
  • Moderate amount of experience working in instructional design, learning management systems, faculty support, integrating technology into teaching in an educational setting or other related experience
  • Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools in course design and instruction

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Blackboard Ultra
